detail.story:
3-WOOD B6 — PROMISING CARRY, PARTIAL SAMPLE. Six retained visible shots average 185.1 yd carry / 218.9 total. Best five average 191.2 carry; longest is 195.3. Shot 7 is a clear carry mishit; shots 5–6 have no distance. Five further shots were off-screen. Mean launch is 10.6° and face-to-path +2.9°; delivery and strike vary. Repeat B6 with the same balls and settings, capturing all rows, before attributing changes to the sleeve or wrist feel.

HI-TOE 58° — ESTABLISH THE NORMAL FLIGHT. Five retained shots average 75.2 carry / 82.4 total, with 34.4° launch. Shots 5 and 7 show 11.8° and 4.1° launch and impact 22/27 mm below center; these reviewed thin/skull outliers are held out of normal-flight averages. The 130.2-yard finish is not a wedge stock yardage. For the next block, repeat a comfortable swing and track carry spread before testing separate partial-swing distances.
detail.limits: Indoor observations, not outdoor stock yardages. Ball and normalization unknown. 3W full-session mean unavailable. Wedge attack-angle and spin-loft have one measured row only. No swing film; wrist mechanics cannot be diagnosed. User reports working through bowed-wrist change; do not attribute numerical differences to that alone.

club.note: Main greenside, bunker and lofted wedge replacing the two benched Vokeys. First sim test Sep 25: 75.2 yd carry / 82.4 total across five normal-flight shots; two clear thin/skull mishits held out. Indoor baseline only; outdoor stock carry and partial-shot distances still uncalibrated.

detail.story: 4-IRON — BASELINE FOR THE RETURNED CLUB. Ten retained shots average 147.2 yd carry / 181.2 total; best-five carry 159.2 and longest carry 169.1. The 104.5-yard, 5.6° launch, 13 ft 2 in apex shot is a reviewed low-flight mishit and held out. The 124.2 and 129.9 carries remain; shorter does not automatically mean a clear mishit. Mean path −6.9° and face-to-path +4.1° show a leftward path with the face open relative to it on most retained shots. All ten curve right, but that is not ten finishes right of target. Face angle itself is unavailable. Next session: keep a comfortable swing and compare carry/height and the path-to-face gap over another complete block. Normalization was ON here and unconfirmed for today’s woods/wedge, so the comparison does not isolate equipment or wrist effects.
detail.limits: Normalization ON; temperature/altitude and ball not shown. Face angle missing. Five attack-angle readings. Indoor baseline, not outdoor stock yardage. Source row IDs are ordinal positions.
